To empirically evaluate the improvements provided by using SpecDiff, the paper provides an empirical analysis on three standard natural language processing tasks: (1) text summarization using the CNN/DM dataset , (2) text generation on the OpenWebText (OWT) dataset , and (3) text generation using MT Bench .
